violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth sanitizer bucket concentration low. Bucket due to be changed.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Grab N Go cooler holding beef/cheese sticks and deli sandwiches running warm. Temping at 47 degrees F.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Board used to secure plumbing to wall at utility sink is rotting.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Wall behind fryer has buildup of grease and needs cleaning.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. The board above the mop sink holding the faucets is bare wood. The edges of the counters in the kitchen area are bare wood. Needs to be a cleanable surface.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. A knife in the drawers by the oven is chipped and no longer in good condition.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside of cappuccino machine and top of the cooler in the kitchen needs to be cleaned.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Paper boats by food warmer were not inverted.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. A bucket was being stored in the hand sink by the three compartment sink.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Mop was stored in the wringer of the mop bucket and not in a position to dry.
